semantic_initial_html: Excellent; initial form and reference content are ordinary crawlable HTML.
enhancement_hydration: Progressive enhancement without hydration runtime; requires disciplined stable-node patching.
accessibility_focus: Excellent when focus and live-region effects are explicit; manual branch coverage is the risk.
lifecycle_cleanup: Explicit AbortController/Scope/finalizer ownership; easy to audit while small.
keyed_lists_grid: Manual stable identity and insertion/removal; complexity grows for simulation and hazard marks.
hazard_svg: Good for local pointer scratch plus semantic marker commands; manual keyed updates can become costly.
testability: Renderer-neutral model is strong; view tests remain straightforward while DOM mutation is centralized.
bundle_closure: Lowest expected closure; local first-party source arm observed at 20620 raw / 5553 gzip, not a production bundle.
offline_static_fit: Excellent; no framework runtime required and service-worker behavior remains standards based.
effect_v4_integration: Use a narrow dispatch bridge to one ManagedRuntime; no Atom requirement.
migration_cost: Low now; rises sharply if project code grows reconciliation infrastructure.
recommendation: Baseline for static/simple islands and one arm of the matched player spike.

semantic_initial_html: Good initial HTML, but later renders replace the interactive subtree.
enhancement_hydration: No maintained hydration semantics; replacement is project-owned.
accessibility_focus: Poor by default; the probe exposed focus loss when acknowledgement rerender replaced the focused node.
lifecycle_cleanup: Delegated listeners simplify some cleanup, but stale-node semantics remain project-owned.
keyed_lists_grid: Poor; replacement discards node identity and selection/focus unless rebuilt manually.
hazard_svg: Poor for active gestures and keyed markers because replacement invalidates live DOM identity.
testability: Useful as a negative control, not as an architecture candidate.
bundle_closure: Observed first-party source at 21662 raw / 5864 gzip; not a production bundle.
offline_static_fit: Standards-only, but behavior risk outweighs size benefit.
effect_v4_integration: Same dispatch bridge as direct DOM; no special integration.
migration_cost: High defect risk and likely path to a custom renderer.
recommendation: Reject as a product renderer; retain only as evidence of replacement/focus hazards.

semantic_initial_html: Good when light DOM and native controls remain visible; shadow DOM can complicate crawlability and form semantics.
enhancement_hydration: Custom-element upgrade supports enhancement, but declarative hydration is not a complete renderer story.
accessibility_focus: Can be strong, but shadow boundaries, form association, labels, and focus require specialist care.
lifecycle_cleanup: connectedCallback/disconnectedCallback provide lifecycle hooks; move/adoption cases must be handled correctly.
keyed_lists_grid: No built-in keyed reconciliation; another renderer or manual code is still needed.
hazard_svg: Possible, but custom elements do not solve high-frequency keyed rendering themselves.
testability: Native lifecycle is testable; cross-browser custom-element/shadow behavior adds matrix cost.
bundle_closure: Potentially small, but no matched production measurement was run.
effect_v4_integration: Project-owned bridge and Scope cleanup; no official Atom binding.
migration_cost: Medium; component API and shadow/light DOM choices become long-lived.
recommendation: Use only for a genuine reusable browser element boundary, not as the primary renderer answer.

enhancement_hydration: Client render is small and declarative; hydration requires separate Lit support and exact validation.
accessibility_focus: Templates preserve semantic authoring, but focus/live-region requests still need an explicit adapter.
lifecycle_cleanup: Event parts and root render simplify listener replacement; external subscriptions still require Scope/finalizers.
keyed_lists_grid: Good through keyed repeat; directly addresses manual reconciliation pressure.
hazard_svg: Good candidate for semantic marker collections while pointer scratch remains local.
testability: Same controller can be exercised through a thin template adapter.
bundle_closure: Actual Vite closure BLOCKED. First-party adapter source excluding dependency was 21001 raw / 5612 gzip.
offline_static_fit: Good; standalone renderer does not require SPA routing or server runtime.
migration_cost: Low to medium from direct DOM; smaller conceptual jump than a component framework.
recommendation: First declarative candidate for the matched Bun/Vite/native-browser rerun; provisional until executed.

semantic_initial_html: Good with SSR/static HTML and hydration, but introduces a component runtime.
enhancement_hydration: Mature render/hydrate APIs; exact island/static integration was not probed.
accessibility_focus: Component model helps composition but does not guarantee accessible semantics or focus behavior.

hazard_svg: Capable, though high-frequency pointer work should stay outside global render state.

semantic_initial_html: Good with static output/hydration and fine-grained client islands.

keyed_lists_grid: Excellent for keyed and independently updating collections.
hazard_svg: Strong full-framework candidate for complex keyed markers and local derived state.

semantic_initial_html: Good with SSR/hydration and progressive component islands.
